command: set -eu; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "eb48b7c3cea379db3d215464efae4dff61ff54c0"; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed -n '1p'); APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK"; echo SERIAL=$SERIAL
